author: A. Aguilar-Arevalo et al.
title: Improved Measurement of the $\pi \to e \nu$ Branching Ratio
abstract:
A new measurement of the branching ratio $R_{e/\mu} = \Gamma(\pi^+ 	o e^+ 
u + \pi^+ 	o e^+ 
u \gamma)/\Gamma(\pi^+ 	o \mu^+ 
u + \pi^+ 	o \mu^+ 
u \gamma)$ resulted in $R^{m exp}_{e/\mu} = (1.2344 \pm 0.0023_{m stat} \pm 0.0019_{m syst}) 	imes 10^{-4}$. This is in agreement with the standard model prediction and improves the test of electron-muon universality to the level of 0.1\%.
